_note: Suggested models per role on the AI providers page; edit freely. Codex: model slug and reasoning effort; Claude: model alias or id.

business_analyst.why: Specs, SRS and discovery extraction: long reading and careful wording more than deep reasoning; raise to high for a large discovery.

tech_lead.why: Plans, SDS, architecture options, onboarding files and UI concepts: design decisions every later step builds on.

qa_analyst.why: Test case design from the spec and plan: systematic coverage of criteria and edge cases.

code_reviewer.why: Reviews, briefs and the disputes it settles on its own: its decisions are applied without a person, so it reads the most carefully.

qa_engineer.why: Writes the test code of approved test cases and the acceptance tests: well specified work.

developer.why: Writes the code that must pass validation within few remediations; a stronger setting saves retries. Use opus on Claude for hard tasks.
